start: Linked member with a plan that covers today; Gym tab

steps.action: Tap 'Ask about your workout' ('Your trainer or the gym owner replies here.')
user_sees: Page 'Ask about your workout': 'Type one question about your workout...', 'Who should answer?' with '<name> (your trainer)' and 'Any trainer or the owner'
must_not: The row shown to a member with no running plan

steps.action: Pick a trainer, type a question
user_sees: The counter '<n> of 500 letters' and 'Send question'
must_not: Text past 500 letters cut without a word

user_sees: 'Sent. The reply will show on this page.' then 'Waiting for a reply. You can ask a new question once this one is answered.'
must_not: Two questions from one tap

steps.action: Trainer replies while the app is closed
user_sees: A phone pop-up titled with the gym name: '<trainer> replied: <answer>' (push, or the 15-minute check if the push was missed)
must_not: Two pop-ups for one reply, or no pop-up while 'Messages from my gym' is on

user_sees: The page with '<trainer> replied' under 'You asked'
must_not: The reply marked seen but not shown

start: Member opens the reply from the Gym tab row instead of the pop-up

user_sees: 'Your gym replied to your question. Tap to read it.' (TalkBack: '1 new reply')
must_not: '1 new replies'

user_sees: The reply under 'Your questions'
must_not: The reply still counted as new after reading

start: Gym has listed no trainers; member sends to anyone

user_sees: 'Your gym has not listed its trainers in the app yet, so the gym owner will answer.'
must_not: An empty picker

steps.action: Pick 'Any trainer or the owner' and send
user_sees: 'To any trainer or the owner'
must_not: The question going to nobody

user_sees: 'Please type your question first.'
must_not: An empty question saved

steps.action: Ask while one is waiting / a 4th question today / to a trainer who left
user_sees: 'You already have a question waiting. Wait for the reply, or take it back first.' / 'You have asked 3 questions today. Please ask again tomorrow.' / 'That trainer is not at your gym any more. Please pick another one.'
must_not: A raw code such as OPEN_QUESTION

steps.action: Send offline, or the server lacks the feature
user_sees: 'Could not send. Check your internet and try again.' / 'Asking about your workout is not ready at your gym yet. Please check again later.'
must_not: 'Sent' for a failed send

user_sees: The row stays, locked: '"Ask about your workout" is for members with a running plan.' with 'Renew my plan'
must_not: Old questions and replies hidden

start: A question waiting, then taken back; one never answered

user_sees: 'You took this question back.'; a new question can be asked
must_not: The trainer still seeing it as open

steps.action: A question gets no reply in time
user_sees: 'No reply came. You can ask again.'
must_not: The member stuck in 'Waiting for a reply' for ever

start: Member sends a question to one trainer

steps.action: Read 'Only the person you pick sees your question. "Any trainer or the owner" sends it to every trainer and the gym owner.' and send
user_sees: Only the picked trainer sees it, as promised
must_not: The gym owner also reading a question sent to one trainer without the app saying so (the promise row notes the server shows it to the owner too)

user_sees: Gym name and the reply text
must_not: Another gym's reply, or a reply popping up on a phone that has left the gym

start: Member trains on a pass (FITPASS, cultpass); Gym tab

user_sees: No 'Ask about your workout' row at all (pass members pay the pass company, not the gym)
must_not: A row that lets a pass member send, or a locked row with 'Renew my plan'

start: Pass member reaches the page by an old link or a kept screen

user_sees: '"Ask about your workout" is for members with a running plan. Your question was not sent.'
must_not: A question saved for a pass member

start: Paying member with old questions is moved to a pass

user_sees: The row goes (hidden for a pass)
must_not: A pop-up still arriving for a reply to an earlier question with no way left to read it
